# rwx_vault_service_account_access_grant (Resource)

Manages access to a locked RWX vault for an RWX service account. Learn more about [locked vaults](https://www.rwx.com/docs/vaults#locked-vaults).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rwx_vault" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

data "rwx_service_account" "deploy" {
  key = "deploy-automation"
}

resource "rwx_vault_service_account_access_grant" "example" {
  vault_id        = rwx_vault.example.id
  service_account = data.rwx_service_account.deploy.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_account` (String) The service account to grant access to. Use `rwx_service_account.<name>.key` for a managed account, or look up an existing account by key or ID with the [rwx_service_account data source](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/rwx-cloud/rwx/latest/docs/data-sources/service_account) and use its `.key` attribute.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) The optional ISO 8601 timestamp when access expires. Omit this attribute for permanent access.
- `vault` (String) The name of the RWX vault to grant access to. Specify exactly one of `vault` or `vault_id`. Changing the selected vault replaces the resource; switching between name and ID for the same known vault does not.
- `vault_id` (String) The stable ID of the RWX vault to grant access to. Reference `rwx_vault.<name>.id` for managed vaults. Specify exactly one of `vault` or `vault_id`. Changing the selected vault replaces the resource; switching between name and ID for the same known vault does not.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stable ID of the access grant.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_vault_service_account_access_grant.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
